policy: Only mechanics explicitly supported by supplied project sources are recorded. Missing activation requirements stay source_insufficient and are not inferred from main-series game rules.

rules.summary: RKS System changes the user's Type to match the Type of its held Memory Disc.

Schooling changes Wishiwashi to Schooling Forme and grants Temporary HP; it returns to Solo Forme when below half maximum HP and no Schooling Temporary HP remains. The two forms have separate Base Stats with the same HP stat.
Minior uses separate Meteor and Core Base Stats with the same HP stat; at half maximum HP or lower it changes from Meteor to Core, and outside combat it returns to Meteor when above half HP.
Power Construct may be used below 50% HP to enter Complete Forme until the end of the Scene, granting Temporary HP while retaining the HP total and maximum of the prior 10% or 50% Forme.
A Zygarde Cube forms 10% or 50% Zygarde from cells. A 100-cell Zygarde with Power Construct may switch between 10% and 50% Formes as an Extended Action and cannot be disassembled.
Viral Fusion bonds the user with a willing or helpless Pokemon and applies source-defined combined traits; Solgaleo and Lunala have specific forms while bonded.

Zacian with an Ancestral Sword and Zamazenta with an Ancestral Shield may enter their Crowned Formes as an Extended Action. The form lasts until Fainted or voluntarily relinquished as an Extended Action and grants the corresponding Behemoth Move.
At the beginning of each turn Morpeko chooses Full Belly Mode or Hangry Mode until its next turn; Full Belly grants an Accuracy bonus and Hangry grants a Damage bonus.
Eiscue is in Ice Face while it has Temporary HP granted by Ice Face and otherwise is in Noice Face; Hail can restore that Temporary HP with the source-defined action.
Zen Snowed changes Galarian Darmanitan into Zen Mode for the rest of the Scene and grants access to Ice Punch and Fire Punch as if on its Move List.

Aegislash defaults to Shield Stance. A damaging attack switches it to Sword Stance and swaps Attack with Defense and Special Attack with Special Defense without changing Combat Stages. King's Shield, Protect, a Status Move that raises Defense Combat Stages, or a Blessing returns it to Shield Stance; it may also change Stance as a Full Action.

Burmy may build Plant, Sandy, or Trash Cloaks from source-defined nearby materials. The cloak adds Grass, Ground, or Steel respectively as secondary Type, is replaced by making another cloak, and is destroyed by Super-Effective damage. The cloak Type becomes permanent upon evolution into Wormadam.

Furfrou's current hairstyle determines the Ability granted by Fabulous Trim: Star/Celebrate, Diamond/Defiant, Heart/Cute Tears, Pharaoh/Sand Veil, Kabuki/Inner Focus, La Reine/Intimidate, Matron/Friend Guard, Dandy/Moxie, and Debutante/Confidence.
The supplied Basculin entry explicitly parameterizes Advanced Ability 2 by color: Reckless for Red and Rock Head for Blue. No runtime switching rule is introduced.

Seasonal is Static and grants an Ability based on the current season: Spring/Run Away, Summer/Grass Pelt, Autumn/Rivalry, Winter/Thick Fat. The supplied rule does not define an Extended Action or persistent manual season-selection mechanic.
As long as Meloetta knows Relic Song, it may switch between Aria Form and Step Form as a Swift Action when using Relic Song, or as a Standard Action otherwise. Both forms must use the same HP Stat.

Dusk Mane and Dawn Wings each contain an Ultra Burst block that becomes Psychic/Dragon with Neuroforce, changes Advanced Ability 1 to Illuminate, gains Glow, and applies source-form-specific Stat deltas. No activation requirement has been found in the supplied project sources.
